watch.en: Warm the yolks with a little of the hot liquid first, then stir them in; keep the sauce below 85 °C (185 °F).
watch.de: Das Eigelb erst mit etwas heißer Flüssigkeit anwärmen, dann einrühren; die Sauce unter 85 °C halten.

why.en: Egg proteins thicken the liquid as they set; above 85 °C (185 °F) the yolks curdle.
why.de: Die Eiweißstoffe im Ei binden die Flüssigkeit, wenn sie stocken; über 85 °C gerinnt das Eigelb.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces, and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Liaison
sources.sentence: Temper the egg yolk and cream mixture by slowly adding a small amount of the hot liquid while stirring continuously.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces, and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Liaison
sources.sentence: Temperatures over 185°F (85°C) will cause the yolks to curdle.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: These types are cooked and the liquid used is thickened by the coagulation of the egg proteins that are added.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.sentence: The gentler these dishes are heated, the greater the safety margin between thickening and curdling.

sources.title: Der junge Koch / Die junge Köchin (Brandes, Harten, Krödel, Voll, Wolffgang), 38th edition, Pfanneberg 2022
sources.place: Suppen und Saucen - Suppen - 3 Gebundene Suppen, Wissenswertes über Herstellungsfehler, p. 621
sources.sentence: Da nur eine leichte Bindung vorhanden ist, flocken die Eigelbe aus, es gerinnt das Eiweiß vom Eigelb.

sources.title: Der junge Koch / Die junge Köchin (Brandes, Harten, Krödel, Voll, Wolffgang), 38th edition, Pfanneberg 2022
